name: BYT Holdings Ltd.
summary: BYT Holdings Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction management solutions primarily in Singapore and Malaysia. The company’s products include cleanroom and control environment, general exhaust, process vacuum, process colling water, reverse osmosis deionization water, compressed dry air, wastewater treatment, supervisory control and data acquisition, and waste management systems. It also offers integrated engineering and waste management services; and informatization solutions and data analysis for National State Grid, as well as shield tunnel big data management platform and intelligent construction solutions. The company is headquartered in Singapore.
